# Federico Cesarini

> AI engineer and consultant in Bergamo, Italy, who builds memory systems for agentic AI. With Marco Sassarini he wrote CROW (Classifier-Routed Organization of LLM Wikis), a paper and open-source LLM wiki with a desktop app, Crow. He is the solo creator of SecondBrain, an AI memory app for iPhone, Android and the web. At Tinexta Innovation Hub he leads the engineering of the main AI features of Lextel.ai, a platform for legal professionals.

## Key facts

- Current role: AI Engineer & Cloud Architect at Tinexta Innovation Hub, since February 2025, on Lextel.ai (Legal Deep Research, AI document generation and an agentic legal chat).
- Creator: SecondBrain, as its solo creator (engineering, product, design and growth), since 2026. Live on the App Store and Google Play, with more than 4,000 users.
- Research: "CROW: Classifier-Routed Organization of LLM Wikis", F. Cesarini and M. Sassarini, Zenodo preprint, September 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23260209.
- What CROW does: in an LLM wiki, a fast classifier takes the routing decisions (where a document belongs, which note to read) and the language model only writes. On 525 real documents, against the same pipeline driven only by a language model: right note read 89% vs 62%, 18.4 s vs 38.6 s per document (2.1x faster), 68% fewer LLM tokens. A cost model keeps it at about $0.006 per document up to a million documents.
- Open source: llm-wiki-v2 (pip install llmwiki2) keeps the wiki as plain Markdown files on your computer, works with any AI provider, Ollama included, cites its sources and can be the long-term memory of Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client. Crow, the free desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, is made with Tauri and React.
- Earlier: Software Engineer & Cloud Architect at Warrant Hub, Bergamo (December 2021 to February 2025): Google Cloud infrastructure for patent data, named-entity recognition models with 85% accuracy, Elasticsearch search by keyword and meaning. Software Developer at GestApp srl (2020). Apple Store retail (2019 to 2020).
- Education: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, Università degli Studi di Bergamo (2017 to 2021).
- Languages: Italian (native), English (C1).
- Contact: federico.cesarini.consulting@gmail.com
